note: cette situation means 'this situation'; English incorrectly says 'that situation'.
proposed_target: Je ne sais pas ce que je ferais dans cette situation.
proposed_english: I don't know what I'd do in this situation.

note: ce truc is singular 'this thing', not mass noun 'this stuff'.
proposed_target: Je ne sais pas quoi faire de ce truc.
proposed_english: I don't know what to do with this thing.

note: ces restes means 'these leftovers', not 'those leftovers'.
proposed_target: Je ne sais pas quoi faire de ces restes.
proposed_english: I don't know what to do with these leftovers.

note: maman is 'mom/mum', more specific in register than formal 'mother'.
proposed_target: Je ne sais pas quand ma maman reviendra.
proposed_english: I don't know when my mom will come back.

note: devons means have to/must; English 'need to' is less exact.
proposed_target: Je ne sais pas pourquoi nous devons faire cela.
proposed_english: I don't know why we have to do that.

note: le faire means 'do it'; English incorrectly says 'do this'.
proposed_target: Je ne pense pas pouvoir le faire sans toi.
proposed_english: I don't think I can do it without you.

note: le refaire means 'do it again'; English says 'do that again'.
proposed_target: Je ne pense pas avoir à le refaire.
proposed_english: I don't think I have to do it again.

note: le faire means 'do it'; English says 'do that'.
proposed_target: Je ne pense pas que nous puissions le faire aujourd'hui.
proposed_english: I don't think that we can do it today.

note: si tôt means 'so early', not 'that soon'.
proposed_target: Je ne pense pas que nous puissions le faire si tôt.
proposed_english: I don't think we can do it so early.

note: risque means risk; English 'chance' changes the connotation.
proposed_target: Je ne pense pas que tu veuilles prendre ce risque.
proposed_english: I don't think you want to take that risk.

note: Standard French is pizzas au pepperoni; keep the plural sense aligned in English.
proposed_target: Je ne comprends pas pourquoi les pizzas au pepperoni sont si populaires.
proposed_english: I don't understand why pepperoni pizzas are so popular.

note: comme cela means 'like that'; English incorrectly says 'like this'.
proposed_target: Je ne veux pas vivre ma vie comme cela.
proposed_english: I don't want to live my life like that.

note: With a noun object, connaître is the standard learner-safe verb for knowing someone's name.
proposed_target: Je ne veux pas que vous connaissiez mon vrai nom.
proposed_english: I don't want you to know my real name.
